description: This file defines a PHP class QualificationLanguageController which extends an abstract controller class. It appears to be part of a web application's backend, specifically a controller managing qualification language-related views for the OrangeHRM system. The controller's primary function is to prepare a Vue.js component named 'qualification-language-list' before rendering.

classes.name: QualificationLanguageController
classes.description: A controller class managing the qualification language view, extending an abstract Vue controller and setting a specific Vue component before rendering.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component 'qualification-language-list' for rendering by setting it as the current component.
